nodes.title: How to use
widgets_values:
## How to use - tested on RTX 3060 12 GB

1. **Driving video** = the motion (a dance, you talking). **Character image** = who should move like that.
2. On the **Wan Animate (Ultimate)** node pick the **Model**:

| Model | Best for | Face video |
|---|---|---|
| Wan 2.2 Animate GGUF (best lip-sync, low VRAM) | talking / lip-sync (timing 95% vs my mouth with face video) | yes, switch it on |
| Wan Animate 2 int8 (12 GB) | dance / full-body motion | not used |

3. **Face video** on = the mouth follows the driving video (without it: 48% timing on the same clip).
4. Describe the character + background, set width/height (the driving clip's shape), **frames** (81 = 3.4 s at 24 fps) and press **Run**.
5. You get the result **with the driving video's own audio**, plus original | result side by side.

**Tip:** the character image must SHOW what should move. An android with a solid faceplate can't talk - give it lips + a jaw.

Double-click the node to see every step. **Colours inside the node:** 🟦 load models · 🟩 your input (pose, face, frames) · 🟪 prompt + conditioning · 🟧 sampling · 🟨 decode + video · ⬛ settings + switches · 🟦‍ cyan = extras (side by side)
